hierarchy.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight leading-tight text-[#1A3B2B]

typography.instructions: Avoid generic sans for headings. Use Fraunces for editorial elegance. Never center by default—use purposeful alignment. Include Google Fonts link for Fraunces and Outfit in index.html.

colors.instructions: Use warm cream as the dominant background. Deep botanical green for text and key actions. No pure white or black. Terracotta and sage for subtle accents. AVOID: standard green/white healthy food cliches. DO NOT use generic gradients.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Minimal borders. Use generous spacing (p-12+) instead of boxes to separate content.
visual_enhancers.images: Treated deliberately—use spotlight effects, slightly clipped frames, and gentle corner radii (rounded-none or very slight rounded-sm).
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay spanning the entire site to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.logo: Create a distinctive original SVG mark for 'The Harvest Theory'. Abstract botanical curve or highly tracked elegant serif lockup. Usable as favicon.

layouts.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing: p-6, p-12, p-16, p-24, py-32. Minimum gap-8 for grids.

home: Hero: Large kinetic hero with line-by-line masked reveal. Subtle 3D/parallax image wrapper.
Brand Statement: Large typography, generous whitespace, asymmetrical alignment.
Marquee: Slow editorial marquee displaying product philosophy.
Featured Products: Overlapping layout or strict bento grid (wide gap-8) showcasing top 3 categories.
Philosophy/Sourcing: Text-heavy editorial section with one striking ingredient image, warm wood accent colors.
Final CTA: Deep green background (#1A3B2B) with cream text.
products: Header: Spacious introduction to the brand's expansive catalog.
Filters/Nav: Horizontal sticky sub-nav. Do not design around tea alone.
Grid: Asymmetrical or staggered product grid. Strong photography with generous whitespace. Minimal copy.
Categories: Botanical beverages, teas, matcha, coffee, traditional foods, seeds, seafood, future wellness.
product_detail_modal: Layout: Split screen. Left side locked sticky image with smooth reveal, right side scrollable content.
Content: Title, precise ingredient list, sourcing story, elegant 'Add to Cart' / 'Explore' button.
story: Layout: Long-scroll editorial narrative. Alternating large imagery and offset text blocks. Warm, calm, confident tone.
contact: Layout: Refined form handling consumer, retail, export enquiries. No default select boxes (use customized Shadcn). Split layout with brand imagery.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use `lenis` for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.reveals: Framer-motion for on-scroll reveals. Use `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}` with `duration: 0.8, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]`.
motion.hero_kinetic: Masked line-by-line text reveal. Wrap lines in `overflow-hidden` spans and translate Y from 100% to 0%.
motion.hover: Restrained hovers. Subtle scale (`scale-[1.02]`) and slow transition for product images (`duration-700 ease-out`).
motion.marquee: One slow editorial marquee (e.g., using `react-fast-marquee`). Serif font, tracking wide, muted colors.

components.navigation: Crystal Glass sticky header (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F6F0]/80) after scroll, with a delicate bottom border (`border-[#E5DFD3]`). Desktop must show inline links, NO hamburger on desktop.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or refined rectangular buttons. Primary: `bg-[#1A3B2B] text-[#F9F6F0] hover:bg-[#254F3A]`. Include `data-testid`.

testing.instructions: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (kebab-case, role-based). Example: `data-testid='hero-cta-button'`

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism (backdrop-blur).
NEVER apply universal transition like `transition: all`.
NEVER center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep text left-aligned for natural reading.
Use modern button styles with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, headers overlaying content, or modals.
Rely heavily on typography and spacing over bounding boxes and borders.
